changed_material.description: Adds a Destruction Fear column to the operation-reference table.
changed_material.assessment: Accurate. Town/City destruction generates 1/2 Fear whether by Damage or direct Destroy, in addition to explicit Fear. Removing or replacing a piece generates no automatic Fear itself; retained Damage can destroy the replacement and then generates Fear for that destroyed replacement type. Existing explicit Spirit exceptions still override the general rule.

primary_citations.passage:
Whenever a City or Town is destroyed (via
Damage or otherwise), it frightens the Invaders.
You generate 2 Fear for each City destroyed and
1 Fear for each Town destroyed (in addition to
any Fear done explicitly by the Power).
If you remove or replace a City/Town, it does not
generate this automatic Fear.

If an Invader has taken Damage equal to or greater than 
its Health (see Invaders, page 15), it is destroyed immediately.
primary_citations.anchor: CORE p18, Damage, Destruction, and Removal

| Instruction | Effect on the piece |
| --- | --- |
| **Damage** | Mark Damage; reaching Health destroys the piece immediately. |
| **Destroy** | Return the specified piece to supply regardless of Health or marked Damage. |
| **Remove** | Take the specified piece off the board without a Damage-to-Health test. |
| **Replace** | Remove the original piece and put the specified new piece in its place, retaining marked Damage. |

changes.prior_text: Fear is island-wide. For each Fear, move one marker from the Fear Pool to Generated Fear. When all **4 per Spirit** markers have moved, earn the top Fear Card face-down, return all markers to the pool and continue with any leftover Fear toward the next card. If earning a card exposes a Terror divider, the new Terror Level applies immediately; its victory condition can end the game at the outcome check. Earning the final card reveals Victory; its text never needs resolving.
changes.current_text:
Fear is island-wide. Process generated Fear **one point at a time**:

1. Move one marker from the Fear Pool to Generated Fear.
2. As soon as Generated Fear holds all **4 per Spirit** markers, earn the top Fear Card face-down. Apply any newly exposed Terror Level immediately, then return all markers to the Fear Pool **before processing the next point**.
3. Repeat for every remaining point of Fear, continuing toward the next card after each refill.

A newly exposed Terror Level changes the victory condition immediately; the game can end at the outcome check. Earning the final card reveals Victory; its text never needs resolving.
